blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Playing through minor back pain, Eya Laure almost didn’t finish another Choco Mucho-Creamline showdown after only starting in the first set and missing the next three. But when her number was called in the fifth set, Laure delivered the telling blows to propel Choco Mucho past Creamline, 23-25, 25-13, 25-23, 22-25, 15-13, in a win that keeps the team’s semifinal hopes alive in the 2026 PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series on Thursday at Smart Araneta Coliseum. “When it comes to a fifth set, I’ll fight until the very end.
